the_day: Anthropic published research on Claude designing protein binders as a leaked Anthropic AI bill drew coverage, a judge kept the OpenAI bugging suspect in custody, ChatGPT Slides gained collaboration features, Google added Gemini tools for small businesses, and Anthropic and OpenAI were each reported to be negotiating large new financing.

items.headline: Anthropic publishes research on Claude designing binders against scorpion neurotoxins
points: Anthropic published a post describing how Claude designed protein binders aimed at scorpion neurotoxins.
Hunterbrook describes the work as an experimental antivenom designed by AI.

items.headline: Leaked Anthropic draft AI bill draws criticism over its harm threshold
points: A draft AI bill attributed to Anthropic has leaked, Semafor and The Washington Post report; Semafor says it has drawn backlash.
Heartlander says it would let federal authorities step in only when more than 50 lives are at stake; Truthout describes a similar threshold.
The New York Sun says Anthropic is lobbying to limit guardrails; today's sources include no Anthropic statement on the draft.

items.headline: Anthropic reportedly in talks with Nscale over second $45 billion deal
points: Unconfirmed: Reuters and Bloomberg, citing sources, report Anthropic and Nscale are negotiating a new AI cloud deal worth $45 billion.
The Financial Times and CNBC also report the talks; W.Media says the deal would involve Nscale's Monarch data center campus.
No deal has been signed or confirmed by either company in today's sources.
